title: Uranium around Church Rock and Crownpoint
text: The western edge of the Grants uranium district, around Church Rock and Crownpoint in McKinley County, is also known as the Gallup subdistrict. It holds more than 50 known uranium occurrences, and its mines produced more than 16 million pounds of uranium oxide between 1952 and 1986. Contamination there, and in the Smith Lake and Nose Rock areas, falls partly under the Navajo Nation's jurisdiction and is being addressed by the federal Environmental Protection Agency. Across the district, open shafts and uncontrolled piles of waste rock remain at many old mine sites.
